_meta.about: Phase 88c. Every technical term once, under the rule that says where its rendering comes from (ROADMAP.md, Phase 88). Renderings are a first draft by a language model, each with its source kind and a confidence; no native speaker has reviewed them, and a catalogue built on them is a draft until one has.
